name: Recall
notes: Functional Groups: the amide-ion pKa now matches the range textbooks give (35 to 38).

name: Recall
notes: Functional Groups: a new course with 22 groups drawn as skeletal structures, the same groups inside aspirin, vanillin, acetaminophen and other real molecules, general formulas, naming suffixes and priority, and a pKa ladder.
Sapiens: The Big Ideas, a new course on the arguments of Yuval Noah Harari's book, with what critics dispute.
Recall it first: Feed cards hide their choices until you have tried to answer from memory. Functional groups also come back in reverse: you see a name and pick the structure.

name: Checked
notes: Independent reviews of 28 courses fixed several hundred items: distractors that were also correct, misquoted verses, wrong dates, accents and tone marks.
World Geography: every capital rechecked, map distractors are now real neighbors, flag distractors are real look-alikes, and Equatorial Guinea's new capital is in.
Reading questions no longer put the right answer in the same place.

name: Library
notes: The Library: 35 full courses, from Spanish, Latin, Greek and Japanese to anatomy, organic chemistry, calculus, logic, the Bible and the arguments for God, written from free, reputable sources such as OpenStax, LibreTexts, COERLL and Project Gutenberg.
Choose what you learn and in what order. Your first course is your focus; the rest mix in.
The Feed: an endless vertical stream of recall cards, new sigils, speaking, readings and quick math, built to replace scrolling. Press F.
Lessons: learn a unit's sigils with examples and audio, check yourself, then lock them in at your gates.
Pictures: name the highlighted part of the heart, a cell or the eye, find countries and states on the map, and recognize flags and elements.
Pronunciation: hear every word, and say it back. The microphone checks you in supported browsers.
Mental math: times tables, squares, powers and shortcuts, plus quick-math gates and adaptive speed drills.

name: Orrery
notes: A new look: an oxblood night sky, brass orbit rings with an engraved dial, gold star shards and a solar Fever.
Updates: Graze now checks for new versions and waits for you to tap Update, so a run is never interrupted.
What’s new: you see this list once after each update.
Install it: on the web, Graze can be added to your home screen and played offline.
Backup files now save directly when you play on the web.

name: Sync
notes: Cloud save inside Claude, encrypted link codes, direct transfer codes and backup files. Everything merges; nothing is overwritten.
Boons after each bonus rush, recall revives, recall chains and reverse gates.
Nine new packs, including Organic Chemistry, Latin, German, Polish, Logic and Philosophy & Theology.
Eight more Codex pages and a Workshop of permanent upgrades.

name: Recall
notes: Recall gates with a spaced-review schedule.
Codex reading pages with comprehension questions.
A daily ritual, a cue you choose, and the Forge for your own material.

name: Fever
notes: Fever mode, power-ups, bonus rushes, hoppers and a soundtrack that builds with your multiplier.

name: First light
notes: One tap, two orbits, grazes, missions and trails.
